authorization_basis: The user instructed the project to continue to completion and run all missing statistical data after the reporting layer and technical rehearsal were complete.
model_policy: Apply the 30 P1-G1-V022 Core-86 checkpoints without retraining, reselection, sign changes, or hyperparameter changes.

primary_hypotheses.H1_geometry_dependence: Combined 74 selects different best K at gamma 0 and 1, and at least four of six external families do so.
primary_hypotheses.H2_market_direction: Validation-frozen market-beta removal reduces abs(A) for Combined 74 and at least four of six external families.
primary_hypotheses.H3_economic_completion: K=1 plus Mkt-RF lowers both raw moments and alpha relative to K=1 in at least four of six external families.
primary_hypotheses.H4_asset_family_dependence: At least three distinct best dimensions appear across the two endpoints and six external families.

reported_uncertainty: For every asset family report 12-month circular-block-bootstrap 95% intervals for A, attenuation, raw-moment completion, and alpha completion; intervals do not alter the point-rule definitions above.
artifact_plan: Six CSV/LaTeX table sets and six figures in PDF, SVG, and 300-dpi PNG.
one_time_rule: Create SEALED_ACCESS_STARTED.json before factor inference. If execution fails after the marker exists, repair only a documented code defect without changing hypotheses, models, assets, metrics, or thresholds; retain every failed artifact.
